mapper.select: SELECT revision_id, rule_key, revision, definition_json, content_hash, source_commit, created_by, created_at FROM rule_revision WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey} AND content_hash = #{contentHash}

SELECT revision_id, rule_key, revision, definition_json, content_hash, source_commit, created_by, created_at FROM rule_revision WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND rule_key = #{ruleKey}

SELECT plan_id, revision_id, compiler_version, plan_json, plan_hash, created_at FROM detection_plan WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND compiler_version = #{compilerVersion} ORDER BY created_at DESC, plan_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE detection_rule SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detection_rule (rule_key, name, description, category, updated_at) VALUES (#{ruleKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{category}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision), 0) FROM rule_revision WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rule_revision (revision_id, rule_key, revision, definition_json, content_hash, source_commit, created_by) VALUES (#{revisionId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{ruleKey}, #{revision}, #{definitionJson}, #{contentHash}, #{sourceCommit,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO detection_plan (plan_id, revision_id, compiler_version, plan_json, plan_hash) VALUES (#{planId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{revisionId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{compilerVersion}, #{planJson}, #{planHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE rule_deployment SET desired_revision_id = #{revisionId,jdbcType=OTHER}, desired_state = #{desiredState}, generation = generation + 1, target_cluster = #{targetCluster}, status = 'PENDING', last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rule_key = #{ruleKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rule_deployment (deployment_id, tenant_id, rule_key, desired_revision_id, desired_state, generation, observed_generation, target_cluster, status) VALUES (#{deploymentId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{ruleKey}, #{revisionId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{desiredState}, 1, 0, #{targetCluster}, 'PENDING')

INSERT INTO rule_deployment_history (deployment_id, tenant_id, rule_key, desired_revision_id, desired_state, generation, status, actor) VALUES (#{deployment.deploymentId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{deployment.tenantId}, #{deployment.ruleKey}, #{deployment.desiredRevisionId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{deployment.desiredState}, #{deployment.generation}, #{deployment.status}, #{actor})
